name: opencode-context-engineering-kit
description: Session handover, token tracking and cross-device context sync for opencode. Writes the live handover into the compaction prompt so state survives context compaction.
_publish_note: Publishing this package alone is not enough: cek.ts is a translator that shells out to the kit's core under .claude/hooks/ and scripts/. An npm install must therefore either vendor those directories or resolve CEK_ROOT to a checkout. See docs/RELEASE_NOTES_3.3.0.md — npm distribution is staged, the supported install today is the local plugin directory.
